slides.title: Cozy season is here. Finds that keep the blanket pile in check.
A big blanket basket
slides.body: Throws get tossed in, not folded. Open top, by the couch. Cozy without the couch avalanche.

slides.title: A sofa arm tray
slides.body: Mug, remote, phone. One flat spot so nothing slips into the cushions.

slides.title: A lidded storage ottoman
slides.body: Sit on it, put feet on it, hide the game controllers in it. Three jobs, one thing.

slides.title: A charging station box
slides.body: Cords go into one box on the side table. No more tangled cable nest on the floor.

slides.title: Timer plug for the lamp
slides.body: Lamp turns on at dusk on its own. Cozy without remembering, and the room feels calmer.

slides.title: Cozy and cluttered are not the same thing. My couch learned that this year.
